retries.before:
Gardens in Southampton range from compact terraced back gardens in Portswood to large quarter-acre plots in Bassett Heath, and the work we do reflects that variety. In Bassett Heath, the long, narrow plots along roads like Saxholm Way sit among mature trees whose roots shape how a garden can be laid out — structural planting, level changes and tree-root protection matter more here than in a typical suburban street. Over in the Portswood conservation area, the generous Edwardian frontages on roads like Brookvale Road are worth planning carefully: paving and fencing changes to front gardens face conservation-area controls, so the layout decisions we make there carry more weight than they might elsewhere. We're a family run team of four, and over 100 jobs completed across Southampton means we've worked on most garden types the city throws at us.

Most of what we do falls across four main areas: [gardener](/gardener/) work covering lawns, hedges, borders and fencing; [landscape gardener](/landscape-gardener/) projects from new patios and paths through to full garden redesigns; [landscape designer](/landscape-designer/) services for homeowners who want a plan before any ground is broken; and a [lawn care service](/lawn-care-service/) for gardens where the grass itself needs proper attention. We also carry out tree work, paving and decking, which you'll find below.

One worry we hear regularly is about groundwork failing later — a patio that settles unevenly or a fence that starts to lean within a year. Every job we price accounts for what's actually underneath: the levels, the drainage and the access, before a quote goes anywhere near a customer.

We cover [landscaping in Romsey](/locations/romsey/), [landscaping in Winchester](/locations/winchester/) and [landscaping in Eastleigh](/locations/eastleigh/), and the villages in between. If you're not sure whether we reach you, give us a call on [CV: phone].
retries.after:
Gardens in Southampton vary enormously. Compact terraced back gardens in Portswood sit at one end of the scale. At the other, Bassett Heath has large detached plots, some close to a quarter acre, where mature trees shape how a garden can be laid out. Long plots with established planting mean structural decisions — how levels change, where roots run, what stays — carry more weight than in a smaller suburban garden.

Portswood's conservation area brings a different set of considerations. The Edwardian frontages on roads like Brookvale Road are generous, but paving and fencing changes to front gardens face conservation area and Article 4 controls. The layout decisions made there matter more than they might in a standard residential street, and getting the planning right before any ground is broken saves trouble later.

We're a family run team of four. Most of our work sits across four main areas. Our [gardener](/gardener/) work covers lawns, hedges, borders and fencing. [Landscape gardener](/landscape-gardener/) projects run from new patios and paths through to full garden redesigns. The [landscape designer](/landscape-designer/) service is for homeowners who want a clear plan before anything is agreed. And our [lawn care service](/lawn-care-service/) is there when the grass itself needs proper attention rather than just a cut.

One concern we hear often is about groundwork that fails later. Every job we price accounts for what is actually underneath: the levels, the drainage and the access, before a figure goes anywhere near a customer.

We work across [landscaping in Romsey](/locations/romsey/), [landscaping in Winchester](/locations/winchester/) and [landscaping in Eastleigh](/locations/eastleigh/), and the villages in between. Call us on [CV: phone] if you want to check whether we cover your area.

Repeats "lower lying ground near the" from faq_answer (How much does landscaping cost in Southampton?). Reword it.
retries.before: Persistent wet patches after rain usually come down to one of three things, and often a combination. First, the ground underneath may drain slowly — Southampton's soils vary across the city, and some areas, particularly lower-lying ground near the Test and Itchen, have been recorded as slowly permeable or seasonally waterlogged. Second, a patio or path surface may fall slightly the wrong way, sending water towards the house or into a low spot rather than away from it. Third, there may be no drain or soakaway in place to take the water once it reaches the lowest point. A surface that lets water through does not, on its own, mean the ground beneath can absorb it — especially where groundwater is higher close to watercourses. Getting this right means looking at the surface, the fall and what is underneath before deciding on a fix.
retries.after: Persistent wet patches usually have one of three causes. The ground beneath may drain slowly — Southampton's soils vary, and some investigated sites show seasonally waterlogged conditions. A paved surface may fall the wrong way, pooling water rather than shedding it. Or there is simply nowhere for the water to go once it reaches the lowest point. We look at all three before recommending any drainage or paving work.

meta_description: Landscaper Southampton from Edens Edge Landscaping. Fixed prices with no hidden costs. Get your free quote today.
home_hero_intro: [CV: company_name] is a landscaper in Southampton, covering Romsey and the surrounding areas. We work to fixed prices with no hidden costs, so the figure you agree before work starts is the figure you pay.
home_content_block_h2: Local Landscaping in Southampton and Nearby Towns
home_content_block_body:
Gardens in Southampton vary enormously. Compact terraced back gardens in Portswood sit at one end of the scale. Bassett Heath sits at the other, with large detached plots, some close to a quarter acre. Mature trees shape how a garden can be laid out, and long plots with established planting mean structural decisions carry more weight than in a smaller suburban garden.

Portswood's conservation area brings a different set of considerations. The Edwardian frontages on roads like Brookvale Road are generous, but paving and fencing changes to front gardens face conservation area and Article 4 controls. Getting the planning right before any ground is broken saves trouble later. Those layout decisions matter more than they might in a standard residential street.

We're a family run team of four. Our [gardener](/gardener/) work covers lawns, hedges, borders and fencing. [Landscape gardener](/landscape-gardener/) projects run from new patios and paths through to full garden redesigns. The [landscape designer](/landscape-designer/) service is for homeowners who want a clear plan before anything is agreed. And our [lawn care service](/lawn-care-service/) is there when the grass itself needs proper attention rather than just a cut.

One concern we hear often is about groundwork that fails later. Every job we price accounts for what is actually underneath: the levels, the drainage and the access, before a figure goes anywhere near a customer.

We work across [landscaping in Romsey](/locations/romsey/), [landscaping in Winchester](/locations/winchester/) and [landscaping in Eastleigh](/locations/eastleigh/), and the villages in between. Call us on [CV: phone] if you want to check whether we cover your area.
home_services_intro: From lawn care and hedge trimming to full garden redesigns, new patios, driveways and tree work, we cover the full scope of landscaping and gardening for homeowners across Southampton and the surrounding area.

cards.card_text: Keeping a garden looking right through the seasons takes consistent, timely attention. Our [gardener](/gardener/) work covers lawn mowing and edging, hedge trimming, weed control, mulching, grass seeding and fencing installation. We'll look at what the garden needs and match the visits to it.

Full garden transformations start with understanding what's underneath. New layouts, paving and paths, retaining walls, drainage and turfing all depend on getting that right first. Our [landscape gardener](/landscape-gardener/) work covers garden levelling and grading, hardscaping, sod installation, water features and pool landscaping. One team, one plan, one agreed price.

Good design removes the guesswork before a spade goes in. Our [landscape designer](/landscape-designer/) service covers custom garden design, patio and pathway layouts and retaining wall design. Drainage planning and planting schemes are included too, so every decision is reasoned and agreed before the build begins.

A lawn that stays soggy after rain, builds up moss or struggles to establish needs more than a regular mow. Our [lawn care service](/lawn-care-service/) covers turf management, grass seeding, weed control, mulching, sod installation and artificial turf. We check the ground conditions first and work from there.

Mature trees need proper care to stay safe and healthy through the seasons. Our [tree service](/tree-service/) covers tree trimming and pruning, tree removal, stump grinding, stump removal, and tree planting and transplanting. We look at the tree in its surroundings before recommending any work, so nothing is taken further than it needs to be.

Patios and driveways that hold water or start to settle point to problems underneath, not just the surface. Our [paving contractor](/paving-contractor/) work covers driveway installation and replacement, patio paving, concrete work and brick paver installation. The base is prepared properly so the surface stays level and drains as it should.

Decking adds a usable outdoor space without the groundwork a patio sometimes requires. Our [deck builder](/deck-builder/) service covers deck design, installation and construction in wood and composite, along with pergola construction, patio enclosures, fencing, deck repair and refinishing. We design around the garden and build it to last through the seasons.

home_why_h2: Why Southampton Homeowners Choose Edens Edge Landscaping

points.point_body: We're a team of four with over 100 jobs completed across Southampton. Large plots with mature trees present different challenges to a compact terraced garden. We plan around what we actually find on site.

We're not a franchise or a large contractor. We take on work we can do properly, price it honestly and see it through without passing jobs along a chain or adding work a garden doesn't need.

steps.step_body: The start date is agreed in advance and the job runs to the plan we've priced. For ongoing maintenance, we'll set a schedule that suits you.

For larger gardens, seed is often the practical choice; if you need the lawn in use quickly, turf gets you there faster. We'll advise when we visit.

faq_items.faq_answer: If something isn't right, call us and we'll come back to look at it. Every job we carry out is done to the standard of reasonable care and skill all trades are required to meet. For most jobs, we can get started the same week. Larger projects take longer to book in. Full garden redesigns, significant paving or drainage work all need a confirmed start date agreed at quote stage. We'll set that with you before anything is scheduled.

faq_items.faq_answer: Yes, the quote is completely free and there's no obligation to go ahead. We'll look at the garden and give you a price for what we've discussed. If you decide not to proceed, that's fine.

Southampton's soils vary, and some investigated sites show seasonally waterlogged conditions. We look at all three before recommending any drainage or paving work.
